## SaaS Vision / Visao SaaS
<!-- source: docs/planning-layers-roadmap.md -->

| Tier | Features |
|------|----------|
| Free (CLI/Skill + Desktop Free) | Everything today — MIT (skills) / BSL (CodeDocs) |
| Desktop Pro | Migration plan, Decision Brief, full docs pack (license key) |
| Pro (Hosted) | Web dashboard, scan history, PDF export, hosted badges |
| Team | Multiple repos, approval workflows, custom templates |
| Enterprise | SSO/SAML, evidence retention, CI/CD integration, SLA |

Note: Desktop app (freemium) is the first commercial product. SaaS is future.
